embedding_text:
IMAGE:
This image shows a Shaktiman SRT-1 Mini Series rotary tiller, a tractor-mounted implement used for soil cultivation. The view highlights the primary drive assembly, including the gearbox, PTO input shaft, and the chain-drive side housing. Technicians can use this to identify the main structural components, blade orientation, and the mounting points for the three-point hitch system.
VISIBLE COMPONENTS:
- gearbox
- PTO input shaft
- three-point hitch frame
- rotary tiller blades
- chain-drive side housing
- depth control skids
- rotor shaft
KEYWORDS:
- Shaktiman SRT-1
- rotary tiller gearbox
- tiller blade replacement
- mini series tiller maintenance
- tractor implement repair
USEFUL FOR:
REPAIR:
- blade replacement
- gearbox maintenance
- chain drive inspection
- three-point hitch adjustment
FAULTS:
- worn or damaged tiller blades
- gearbox oil leaks
- chain drive tension issues
- PTO shaft seal failure
